recognize_zh: 中期細胞 FISH 上，MYC 分離探針與 KMT2A 探針訊號在 add(8)(q24) 與兩個環狀染色體上呈多組重複聚集；右側核型可見 add(8)(q24) 與兩個標記環狀染色體，代表 MYC 與 KMT2A 以擴增形式存在於環狀染色體中。
features: Metaphase FISH (A): MYC dual-color break-apart probe plus KMT2A (green)-MLLT3 (orange) dual-fusion probe
Multiple clustered green (KMT2A) and orange signals on an add(8)(q24) chromosome and on two ring chromosomes (arrows), indicating extra copies/amplification
Normal-appearing single signals on other chromosomes for comparison
Karyotype (B): add(8)(q24) and two marker ring chromosomes (mar); sex chromosomes shown as X with Y faded in the template
No KMT2A-MLLT3 fusion pattern evident; signal clustering indicates gain rather than rearrangement
describe_en: Composite cytogenetic figure. Metaphase FISH using a MYC break-apart probe and a KMT2A/MLLT3 dual-fusion probe shows multiple clustered signals located on an abnormal chromosome 8 with additional material at 8q24 and on two ring chromosomes, consistent with multiple extra copies (amplification) of MYC and KMT2A. The G-banded karyotype confirms add(8)(q24) and two marker ring chromosomes. Interpretation: MYC and KMT2A amplification carried on ring chromosomes/add(8q), a complex, adverse-risk finding in acute myeloid leukemia that should be distinguished from KMT2A rearrangement.

ddx.vs: Rearrangement shows split or fused signals at a single locus rather than multiple clustered copies of the KMT2A signal.

ddx.dx: Double minute chromosomes with MYC amplification
ddx.vs: Double minutes appear as tiny paired acentric bodies scattered in the metaphase, whereas here amplicons reside in ring chromosomes and add(8q).
Polysomy gives one signal per extra whole chromosome 8, not tandem clustered signals on marker chromosomes.
